data.name: One Foot in the Grave
data.description: You gain immunity to cold, nonlethal damage, paralysis, and sleep. Your DR increases to 8/-. Unintelligent undead don't notice you unless you attack them. You receive a +4 morale bonus on saving throws made against spells and spell-like abilities cast by undead. You have these benefits constantly, even while not bloodraging.
